Your sealed room is filling with CO2 and you're suffocating. The §6CO2 Scrubber§f fixes that.

This single block pulls carbon dioxide out of the air and replaces it with breathable oxygen. Each cycle consumes one Carbon Brick, so keep a supply handy. Without the scrubber, an enclosed room accumulates CO2 fast enough to kill.

Place it next to an Oxygen Vent for a closed-loop air system. The vent pushes oxygen out, the scrubber pulls CO2 in. Stick a chest of Carbon Bricks next to it for auto-refueling.

This is the second half of the AR life support system. The first half is the Oxygen Vent (quest 10051). You need both.

§ePS:§f The scrubber consumes one Carbon Brick per cycle. Keep a stockpile, a dead scrubber means a dead crew.
